introduction: Minnesota’s refundable Child Tax Credit is claimed through the state income-tax return. Qualifying children must be younger than 18.
description: Minnesota’s refundable Child Tax Credit is claimed through the state income-tax return. Qualifying children must be younger than 18.

sections.who: Use Schedule M1DQC to identify qualifying children and M1CWFC to calculate the credit. Income and residency affect eligibility.
sections.get: A refundable credit can produce a refund without tax due. Eligible filers can elect advance payments under separate rules.
sections.docs:
• Child and dependent records.
  • Income and residency information.
  • Any advance-payment records.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the correct tax year

    Read Revenue’s Child Tax Credit guidance.

  2. Complete the schedules

    Use M1DQC and M1CWFC with the Minnesota return; part-year residents also need the applicable allocation.

  3. File the return

    Submit electronically or by mail, retaining copies.
sections.after: Check advance-payment rules before electing them and retain records for the following return.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Minnesota Child Tax Credit. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
